import sys
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
import datetime as _real_datetime

    mock = MagicMock(spec=_real_datetime)

    mock_dt = MagicMock(spec=_real_datetime.datetime)
    mock_dt.__class__ = _real_datetime.datetime
    mock_dt.now.return_value = datetime_now
    mock.datetime = mock_dt
    
    # timedelta
    mock.timedelta = _real_datetime.timedelta
    
    # timezone
    mock.timezone = _real_datetime.timezone
    
    # Other needed attributes
    mock.MINYEAR = _real_datetime.MINYEAR
    mock.MAXYEAR = _real_datetime.MAXYEAR
    
    return mock

def monkeypatch_datetime(monkeypatch):
    """Replace datetime module in sys.modules with a mock.

    def _impl(date_today, datetime_now=None):
        if datetime_now is None:
            datetime_now = _real_datetime.datetime.now()
        
        mock_mod = _make_datetime_mock(date_today, datetime_now)
        monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, 'datetime', mock_mod)
        return mock_mod
    return _impl
'''
